title: ImportRequest
description: An operator imports one building into the service (spec §6, §11; IMPORT_BUILDING, v0.3 §5). The building is named by the route, the lease by the `X-3DQM-Lease` header. The service resolves the input dataset, the CityObject and the `progress.save` dataset from the CP document through its `buildings` port, never from the client (D-3D133-1). Reply: `import-report` (201); a building that already has a baseline -> 409 VERSION_CONFLICT, nothing changed.
$comment: [P] Shape (D-3D133-3): empty, like the IMPORT_BUILDING payload (Q-32).
